label: Hyperliquid (perpetuals)
terms_note: Public POST /info endpoint, no credentials (a wallet address is enough to read its orders). Orders go through POST /exchange with an EIP-712 wallet signature and are not mapped.

discovery.auth: none (public market data); signed private endpoints not mapped

rate_limits: aggregated REST weight 1200 per minute per IP; l2Book/allMids/clearinghouseState weight 2, all other documented info requests weight 20 (candleSnapshot adds weight per 60 items)

reference.verdict: has_api: yes (public info endpoint, typed JSON bodies).
auth: 1. /info requests are unauthenticated: POST with Content-Type: application/json and a {"type": ...} body.
2. /exchange (orders, cancels, transfers) requires an EIP-712 signature from the wallet's private key (not mapped: the runtime signs with HMAC only).

endpoints.notes: response is an object keyed by coin: {"APE": "4.33245", ...}
response {coin, time, levels: [[{px, sz, n}, ...] (bids), [{px, sz, n}, ...] (asks)]}
startTime/endTime required inside req; response [{t, T, s, i, o, c, h, l, v, n}] (prices as strings); max 500 elements
response is a positional array [meta, [{funding, openInterest, prevDayPx, dayNtlVlm, premium, oraclePx, markPx, midPx, impactPxs, dayBaseVlm}]]
response [{coin, limitPx, oid, side (A|B), sz, timestamp}]

reference.limits: REST weight 1200/minute per IP; l2Book, allMids, clearinghouseState, orderStatus, spotClearinghouseState, exchangeStatus weigh 2; other info requests 20; userRole 60.

me.note: Public info endpoint, no credentials: the probe posts {"type": "meta"} (weight 20).

list_markets.note: Perpetuals universe (weight 20); every market is quoted in USDC and returned in one response (no pagination; `query` is not sent).

get_ticker.note: Top of the L2 book (weight 2): levels[0] are bids, levels[1] asks; prices are decimal strings on the wire and are returned as numbers (num:, as the vocabulary types bid/ask). `last`/`volume` are not available per symbol (allMids is a coin-keyed map and metaAndAssetCtxs a positional array the runtime cannot index by symbol).

list_orders.note: Open orders of PLATFORM_MCP_HYPERLIQUID_WALLET_ADDRESS (weight 20); `side` is B (bid/buy) or A (ask/sell). `symbol`/`status` are not sent.

not_offered.get_candles: candleSnapshot requires req.startTime and req.endTime in milliseconds (docs: both required); the vocabulary carries no time range and the runtime has no millisecond clock expression, so a latest-N request cannot be built.
not_offered.get_balances: clearinghouseState reports perp margin as one marginSummary object plus assetPositions (positions), not per-asset balance rows; spot balances are served by hyperliquid_spot.
not_offered.place_order: orders and cancels go through POST /exchange with an EIP-712 typed-data signature produced by the wallet's secp256k1 private key (docs: 'signing … is done with the private key of the agent or main wallet'); the runtime only has HMAC request signing, so writes are not offered
not_offered.cancel_order: orders and cancels go through POST /exchange with an EIP-712 typed-data signature produced by the wallet's secp256k1 private key (docs: 'signing … is done with the private key of the agent or main wallet'); the runtime only has HMAC request signing, so writes are not offered

config_fields.name: wallet_address
config_fields.help: Public 0x address (42 hex characters) of the MAIN wallet whose orders/balances to read. Not a secret; no private key is needed or accepted. Only list_orders/get_balances use it.

notes: An agent wallet cannot withdraw by construction; the address you paste is checked to be an approved agent of the main wallet.

live_check.notes: fixed: ticker bid/ask were decimal strings (schema-invalid); now numbers. Account tools verified with the public zero address (empty lists); also: next_page now null (no page parameter); all read tools answered, schema-valid
